desc: Ideation: f(x,y) = max edge on MST path (minimax property); assignment via Hungarian; note K-scale risk
Implement Kruskal with DSU to extract MST adjacency (N-1 edges)
Iterative DFS/BFS from vertex 1 to set depth, parent, max-edge-to-parent; build binary lifting tables up[k][v], mx[k][v]
Implement query(a,b) returning max edge on path in O(log N)
Build K×K cost matrix C[i][j] = query(A_i, B_j) (positions, duplicates handled naturally)
Implement Hungarian (O(K^3), 1-indexed potentials, 64-bit) and output minimum total
Sanity-check logic against samples mentally (sample1→8, sample2→3); ensure fast I/O and no recursion limits hit
